# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.0 Worker 2 Slot 85: Late 4D Hegemons 0-Override Deepening & Anti-Hegemon Tension Cache (oe_heg2_, 0 vanilla/GUI overrides). Generated by gen_late_hegemons.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Exact EU5 1.4.9 hegemony type checks (ALWAYS is_hegemon_type = hegemony:<id>, NEVER hegemon:!).
oe_heg2_is_mil_hegemon = {
	is_hegemon_type = hegemony:military_hegemon
}

oe_heg2_is_nav_hegemon = {
	is_hegemon_type = hegemony:naval_hegemon
}

oe_heg2_is_eco_hegemon = {
	is_hegemon_type = hegemony:economic_hegemon
}

oe_heg2_is_cul_hegemon = {
	is_hegemon_type = hegemony:cultural_hegemon
}

oe_heg2_is_dip_hegemon = {
	is_hegemon_type = hegemony:diplomatic_hegemon
}

# Tool access wrappers (native hegemony OR active Dev Page 81 simulation flag).
oe_heg2_can_use_mil_tools = {
	OR = {
		is_hegemon_type = hegemony:military_hegemon
		has_variable = oe_heg2_sim_multi_heg
	}
}

oe_heg2_can_use_nav_tools = {
	OR = {
		is_hegemon_type = hegemony:naval_hegemon
		has_variable = oe_heg2_sim_multi_heg
	}
}

oe_heg2_can_use_eco_tools = {
	OR = {
		is_hegemon_type = hegemony:economic_hegemon
		has_variable = oe_heg2_sim_multi_heg
	}
}

oe_heg2_can_use_cul_tools = {
	OR = {
		is_hegemon_type = hegemony:cultural_hegemon
		has_variable = oe_heg2_sim_multi_heg
	}
}

# Country scope: simultaneously holds 2+ vanilla hegemons (or Dev simulation active).
oe_heg2_is_multi_hegemon = {
	OR = {
		oe_heg2_held_count >= 2
		has_variable = oe_heg2_sim_multi_heg
	}
}

# Country scope: per-dimension national power thresholds for accelerated Tier 2 / Tier 3 promotion.
oe_heg2_meets_mil_t2 = {
	regular_army_size >= 60
}

oe_heg2_meets_mil_t3 = {
	regular_army_size >= 120
}

oe_heg2_meets_nav_t2 = {
	total_sub_unit_count:navy_heavy_ship >= 40
}

oe_heg2_meets_nav_t3 = {
	total_sub_unit_count:navy_heavy_ship >= 90
}

oe_heg2_meets_eco_t2 = {
	monthly_income_trade_and_tax >= 250
}

oe_heg2_meets_eco_t3 = {
	monthly_income_trade_and_tax >= 600
}

oe_heg2_meets_cul_t2 = {
	OR = {
		average_country_literacy >= 25
		culture.cultural_influence >= 150
	}
}

oe_heg2_meets_cul_t3 = {
	OR = {
		average_country_literacy >= 45
		culture.cultural_influence >= 300
	}
}

# Country scope: null-safe Tier >= 2 checks per dimension.
oe_heg2_mil_tier_at_least_2 = {
	has_variable = oe_heg2_mil_tier
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_mil_tier }
		var:oe_heg2_mil_tier >= 2
	}
}

oe_heg2_nav_tier_at_least_2 = {
	has_variable = oe_heg2_nav_tier
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_nav_tier }
		var:oe_heg2_nav_tier >= 2
	}
}

oe_heg2_eco_tier_at_least_2 = {
	has_variable = oe_heg2_eco_tier
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_eco_tier }
		var:oe_heg2_eco_tier >= 2
	}
}

oe_heg2_cul_tier_at_least_2 = {
	has_variable = oe_heg2_cul_tier
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_cul_tier }
		var:oe_heg2_cul_tier >= 2
	}
}

oe_heg2_has_any_tier2_plus = {
	OR = {
		oe_heg2_mil_tier_at_least_2 = yes
		oe_heg2_nav_tier_at_least_2 = yes
		oe_heg2_eco_tier_at_least_2 = yes
		oe_heg2_cul_tier_at_least_2 = yes
	}
}

# Any scope: null-safe Anti-Hegemon Tension Index thresholds (consumed internally & by W3).
oe_heg2_tension_high = {
	has_global_variable = oe_heg2_tension
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_tension }
		global_var:oe_heg2_tension >= 50
	}
}

oe_heg2_tension_critical = {
	has_global_variable = oe_heg2_tension
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_tension }
		global_var:oe_heg2_tension >= 80
	}
}
